disambiguation: Not just a clipper; it organizes saved content into a visual, searchable bento wall within the vault.
extras: No servers, analytics, or telemetry; all data remains local in the vault.
motivation: Links rot, posts get deleted, and a folder of clippings is a list of names. Goko puts everything you save on one wall, as the pictures and video you saved it for, and copies them into your vault so they outlive the page.
problem: Traditional bookmark lists are static and prone to link rot, failing to preserve the visual content of saved media and articles.
summary: Goko is a visual clipping tool that collects links, images, videos, and PDFs into a customizable bento wall within the Obsidian vault.
